title: r0mh-results-v1
description: One machine's risc0-metal-hybrid benchmark contribution. Every measured timing MUST trace to a captured evidence bundle on the contributing machine; a machine that was not run carries status 'not_measured' and no timings. Each measured workload additionally carries a per-workload 'evidence' block that pins the exact CSV/log files behind that row's numbers (sha256), so a reader can trace any single number to a file, not just to a top-level pointer.

chip.description: Human chip name as reported by `sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string`, e.g. 'Apple M4 Max'.

chip_key.description: Filename-safe key, e.g. 'apple-m4-max'. Matches the results/<chip_key>.json filename.

status.description: 'measured' requires real timings + an evidence bundle; 'not_measured' is a placeholder for hardware no one has run yet.

not_measured_reason.description: Required when status is 'not_measured', e.g. 'awaiting hardware — not measured'.

gpu_cores.description: GPU core count for this chip variant. May be 0 if unknown for a placeholder.

metal_argument_buffers_tier.description: 'Tier2' is risc0-zkp's requirement for the Metal HAL; the lane probe asserts it.

bench_runs.description: Measured runs per lane (excludes the warm-up). The published M4 Max protocol used 8.

workloads.description: One entry per workload, each carrying both lanes AND a per-workload evidence block. Empty when status is 'not_measured'.

name.description: Workload id: hello | busy | hash | ecdsa | shaheavy | mempress | multiseg.

segments.description: Segment count of the proof (structural property of the workload at the pinned knobs).

speedup.description: cpu.median_ms / metal.median_ms, reported exactly as measured (may be near 1.0 for circuit-heavy guests).

evidence.description: Top-level pointer to the primary captured evidence bundle for this file. When a file's rows span more than one bundle (e.g. a validate.sh suite plus a bench-adopter run), this points at the primary suite bundle and each workload's own 'evidence' block carries that row's exact provenance.

bundle.description: Relative path or release-asset name of the primary evidence bundle, e.g. 'evidence/20260614T...Z'.

evidence_json_sha256.description: sha256 of the primary bundle's evidence.json.

measured_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the run, e.g. '20260614T...Z'.

median_ms.description: Median of `runs` serial proving runs (run_ms), from the captured CSV.

receipt_verified.description: MUST be true. A run whose receipt did not verify is not a result — it is a failure to fix. The harness verifies + asserts the journal on every run.

workload_evidence.description: Per-workload provenance: the exact captured files behind THIS workload's numbers. A reader hashes the named files in the cited bundle and compares. CSV/profile hashes are nullable ONLY when the file does not exist in that bundle (e.g. validate.sh profiles only `hello`); when null, 'notes' must say why and the row still anchors to the bundle's evidence JSON. No hash is ever invented.

bundle.description: Relative path or release-asset name of the bundle these timings came from, e.g. 'evidence/20260614T...Z' or 'evidence/adopter-20260615T...Z'.

evidence_json_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle's canonical machine-readable evidence JSON: 'evidence.json' for a scripts/validate.sh bundle, 'summary.json' for a scripts/bench-adopter.sh bundle. 'notes' states which one.

metal_csv_sha256.description: sha256 of bench/<name>-metal.csv in the bundle (the metal-lane per-run CSV). null only if absent, with a reason in 'notes'.

cpu_csv_sha256.description: sha256 of bench/<name>-cpu.csv in the bundle (the cpu-lane per-run CSV). null only if absent, with a reason in 'notes'.

profile_log_sha256.description: sha256 of the per-phase profile log for this workload (logs/profile-<name>-metal.log). null only if absent, with a reason in 'notes'.

notes.description: Short provenance note: which JSON anchors the bundle, why any hash is null, and which protocol/run the row came from.
